swe_bench_verified.name: SWE-bench Verified
swe_bench_verified.description: Human-validated subset of 500 real GitHub issues. Evaluates an LLM agent's capability to resolve actual software bugs and write pull requests in complex open-source codebases.

swe_bench_pro.name: SWE-bench Pro
swe_bench_pro.description: Enterprise-grade software engineering benchmark with intricate, multi-file code modifications and strict automated test harnesses.

livecodebench.name: LiveCodeBench
livecodebench.description: Contamination-free competitive programming benchmark collected continuously from LeetCode, AtCoder, and Codeforces to test true generalization.

terminal_bench_2_1.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
terminal_bench_2_1.description: Evaluates an AI agent's ability to operate in real bash/terminal environments, execute CLI scripts, troubleshoot servers, and use command-line developer tools.

mcp_atlas.name: MCP Atlas
mcp_atlas.description: Evaluates autonomous agents on complex multi-turn workflows utilizing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to interact with external tools and services.

tau_bench.name: Tau-Bench
tau_bench.description: Measures conversational agents' ability to reason, call dynamic APIs, and follow strict user policies in airline, banking, and retail domains.

aime_2026.name: AIME 2026
aime_2026.description: American Invitational Mathematics Examination (2026). Tests deep multi-step mathematical Olympiad reasoning and analytical problem-solving.

gpqa_diamond.name: GPQA Diamond
gpqa_diamond.description: Google-Proof Q&A Diamond subset: extremely difficult PhD-level questions in physics, chemistry, and biology designed to be resistant to web search.

hle.name: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE)
hle.description: Cross-disciplinary benchmark spanning mathematics, humanities, and sciences testing frontier AI reasoning at the upper limits of academic knowledge.

mmlu_pro.name: MMLU-Pro
mmlu_pro.description: A significantly more robust and challenging version of MMLU with 10 options per question, requiring genuine multi-step reasoning over memorization.

osworld_verified.name: OSWorld-Verified
osworld_verified.description: Multimodal benchmark assessing an agent's capability to operate a real operating system desktop VM (GUI clicks, window management, keyboard, and cross-application workflows).

mmmu_pro.name: MMMU-Pro
mmmu_pro.description: Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding Pro subset. Rigorous university-level visual reasoning across charts, diagrams, and technical documents.

math_vision.name: MathVision
math_vision.description: Evaluates visual mathematical problem solving from competition-level geometry diagrams, plots, and graphical mathematical problems.
